mapping_policy.principle: Map MITRE ATT&CK techniques only when observed behavior is supported by available evidence.

detections_reviewed.reason: The IOC matched an IP and port, but all associated connections were S0 with no observed response or transferred bytes. Payload delivery or execution is not established.
Threat intelligence classifies the indicator as botnet C2, but the observed PCAP evidence only shows unanswered connection attempts. Command-and-control behavior is not independently confirmed.

The case-specific IOC matches establish network communication with the listed indicators. HTTP GET, DNS and TLS observations alone do not independently establish command-and-control behavior or another specific ATT&CK technique. No technique is confirmed.

candidate_techniques.required_evidence: Observed HTTP or HTTPS communication independently linked to command-and-control activity.
Observed DNS communication independently demonstrating command-and-control behavior, not merely a DNS IOC match.

summary.conclusion: No MITRE ATT&CK technique is confirmed by the currently reviewed PCAP evidence. Candidate techniques remain documented for further investigation only.
